The supplied overview snapshot digest does not match fetched HTML, with no historical snapshot bytes or extraction procedure available; the supplied sdg-4-scorecard URL returned 404. verdicts.method: Independently fetched UNESCO https://www.unesco.org/gem-report/en and https://www.unesco.org/reports/gem-report/en/2026 on 2026-09-11. This verifies the descriptive summary, not causal impact or independent accuracy of the underlying UNESCO estimates.

It states almost the same finding as the claim, close enough to read as the same source: completion rates have continued to increase, especially upper secondary, 'unlike out-of-school rates that have stagnated, a paradox related to a decrease in repetition rates' -- and separately discusses large between-country differences and disparity 'by sex, location, wealth and disability', i.e. equity gaps persisting under rising averages.
